sources._src_cells: September 2026 games, none in the rule's fit (197,191 positions; earlier candidates were scored on them, tests.candidates_sept): release-2.1/calib-fit/win21-sept.plot.json (accuracy, blunder rate, the README figure's data) (blunder_points: calib_fit.move_metrics) and release-2.1/video-refresh/cells.json (Elo gaps on the humans' curve: accuracy, blunder rate; median beta and leaves at COST; share with no search). stockfish_depth: analysis/elo_strength/calib_mpv.py. rms: per time control, debiased, cells.json; allie20: calib-fit/var20-sept.json, the same curve and games. raw_read: classical 2400, Allie alone against the humans on accuracy and blunder rate, not from games played. slope: through the human curve's local slope, the cell's raw_elo. direct: where its numbers sit on the human curve itself, between cells at their mean rating, the blunder rate in logs.
sources._src_tests: Allie 2.1: calib-fit/win21-sept.json (11), calib-fit/bot21-fit-july.json outside_held (5). Allie 2.0: calib-fit/var20-sept.json (8), src/allie/lichess/calibration.py at commit cad41559 (2 held out). Rules and parameters: docs/DETAILS.md, Calibrated play. variants, one_rule_july: calib-fit/var21b-july.json, its 8 variants' held-out misses and the range of its four one-rule variants. candidates_sept: calib-fit/var21-sept.json, the three earlier candidates scored on September. ce: September, nats against the raw prediction, the same files. bullet_2000_july_z: bot21-fit-july.json, the halves pooled.
sources._src_rule: src/allie/lichess/calibration.py; the fit's size from its docstring (July 2026 games).
sources._src_live: release-2.1/load-own/21-four-c1.0.json (four games at a human pace, docs/DETAILS.md Inference). ms_per_move: a move without search, README. batched_leaf_ms: a leaf in a search, batched: 5.2 ms in the four-game test (DETAILS), 5.7 ms in this position's search (position.search_seconds over 1,024 leaves); the rule budgets rule.cost. offset: src/allie/lichess/README.md, measured on Allie 2.0 only (2,223 games, 2026-10-06 to 10-17, 53 +- 8 Elo above its rating in games decided on the board); Allie 2.1's own live measure has not happened.

aggregates._src_blind_spot: Moves Allie 2.1's raw prediction gives at least 10%, on the 197,191 September 2026 calibration positions (none in the fit): humans' plays over Allie's summed probability, per time control and 200-point bin, split by Stockfish (blunder: 15+ points of win chance lost; fine: the rest). hits, predicted: the blunder ratio's numerator and denominator. tilted: the same hits over the rule's probability as played. lo, hi: 95%, 1,000 bootstrap draws over games. by_think: the ratio by tercile of predicted think time, within classical 2000-2600; it barely moves. Priors release-2.1/calib/sept-{256,512,1024}, Stockfish calib-sept/mpv-human. New for this video.
aggregates._src_tilt_reach: bullet/800, blitz/800: the rule's beta times scale at every position, rungs mixed as played; beta is the cell's median after scaling. ce: nats against the raw prediction. Nothing here tests a higher floor on other cells.
aggregates._src_roads: The same positions, per cell. temperature: the raw prediction to the power 1/t. tilt: the shipped rule with beta times scale, its rungs mixed by the think-time draws as calib_unified scores it. shipped: scale 1. leaves: the shipped beta at one search size (a position lacking the rung reads its largest). ce: nats against the raw prediction. replay_gap: worst difference from the README figure's own calibrated accuracy or blunder rate, which interpolates beta on a grid.
aggregates._src_typical: Median over positions of the share of probability the shipped rule moves (total variation from the raw prediction), per cell, rule as played.

position._src: Ply 52 of a September 2026 game of the calibration set (row 146127 of positions-human.npz), picked by hand among the positions where a move Stockfish calls a blunder holds at least 20% of the prediction and the tilt removes it, replayed on the released Allie 2.1 (release-2.1/hf: int8, Rust engine) with the bot's settings (calibration.py): treers.KL, the bot's searcher, for by_rating and search_seconds; kl.py's forest for the tree and each rung's values (rung r: the nodes of cost <= r); forest_vs_bot: their largest difference in a root value. values_so_far: the two moves' values on the log-odds scale, arctanh(0.98 (W - L)), half the log odds, at each leaf count in leaf_steps; the video reads them as White's expected score, (1 + tanh(v) / 0.98) / 2. KL search: src/allie/search/kl.py, after piKL (Jacob et al., 2022). stockfish: calib-sept/mpv-human, depth 10, cp for White. white_q: the node's own read, W - L for White, under the view. search_seconds is wall time on the measuring node: it moves with the node's load (5.6-6.8 s seen).
position._src_think: behaviour.think drawn 100,000 times at this position's clock, the rung by calibration.affordable at COST. played: each root move's chance over those draws, rung by rung, at the game's own beta.
